text:
ana: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem. I put a compact remediation list in the tracker: https://tiny.redwood/pm-authz-follow. Please confirm owners and ETA.
derrick: I can own token validation schema changes and the audit-log schema (row 2). ETA next Wed. Will add sample payloads.
marta: I'll take secrets rotation automation (row 4). Plan: KMS key rotation + CI token purge, ETA 2 weeks. Will create PM ticket.
sam: I will own permissions cleanup (role pruning) and add PR with the role-to-service map. ETA one sprint.
security-bot: Created PM-5120 (audit-schema), PM-5121 (secrets-rotation), PM-5122 (role-prune). Links in tracker.
nana: small note: we found recurring issue where ephemeral tokens are issued with no ttl. Can we add a CI check to block missing ttl fields?
derrick: Yep. I'll add a linter rule and pre-commit hook example to PM-5120.
marta: For rotation: proposal is dual-key rollout to avoid downtime. Will include rollback steps and test plan in PM-5121.
sam: I'll add a column in the sheet to mark "legacy_services" so we can separate migrations.
ops-bot: Weekly follow-up scheduled for PM-5120/5121 every Tue 09:00 PT. Invite to owners.
nana: Compliance ask: add retention justification and GDPR tags to each PM before marking complete.
derrick: acked, adding sample logs and retention notes.
marta: PR branch created: git/redwood/pr/1420. Will attach in ticket.
nana: Great. If anything becomes customer-impacting add `blocking` label and ping #eng-oncall per runbook. Closing for now, pls update tracker when changes made. :thumbsup:
